subject: Provisional PO request + line-item split for Skyline Systems go-live
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>, Maya Evers <maya@skyline-sys.com>
Date: 2026-12-08T08:03:00-08:00
Subject: Request: provisional PO and line-split for Skyline go-live

Hi team,

Quick background: Skyline Systems is scheduled to go live with our private deployment next Monday (12/13). Procurement flagged that their onboarding packet is missing a tax ID and the full vendor verification will take until next week. The customer needs a provisional PO to allow billing for initial setup work from Skyline while we finish paperwork.

What we need from Procurement/Finance:
- Issue a provisional PO (provisional status) that allows Skyline to invoice up to $25,000 total.
- Split the PO into two line items:
  1) "Deployment Setup (SKU: RDW-DEP-BASE)" — estimated $15,000
  2) "Data Ingest & Integration (SKU: RDW-ING-ADV)" — estimated $10,000
- Tag PO with a staging code and a note that this is temporary pending tax docs (W-9/TIN) and final PO will replace it.

I attached the onboarding form they submitted (skyline_onboard_form.pdf). Maya — can you confirm whether they can accept invoices against a provisional PO?

Goal: get provisional PO in place by EOD 12/08 so their engineers can start provisioning.

Thanks,
Connor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0173
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Maya Evers <maya@skyline-sys.com>
Date: 2026-12-08T09:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: provisional PO and line-split for Skyline go-live

Thanks Connor — copying finance (Marcus) for approval. A few clarifying questions for the vendor (Maya):
1) Confirm acceptance of a provisional PO (will they invoice against it or require a hard PO number in their AP?).
2) Confirm the legal entity name and billing address to ensure PO matches their invoices.
3) Can they provide a signed W-9 or equivalent tax document before next Wednesday? If not, we need to mark the PO as provisional and limited to a shorter spend cap.

Internally Marcus: if we approve provisional status, do you prefer a 2-line split with 15k/10k caps or a single-line provisional with an internal hold?

Irene Choi
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwoodinference.com
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Maya Evers <maya@skyline-sys.com>
Date: 2026-12-08T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: provisional PO and line-split for Skyline go-live

Irene/Connor — approve provisional issuance with the following controls:
- Create PO with two explicit line items as requested (15,000 and 10,000).
- Apply provisional tag "PO-STG-947" in the PO notes and the memo field in the ERP.
- Restrict invoice acceptance to the line items listed; any invoice exceeding an individual line must be blocked pending additional approval.
- Provisional PO expiry: 14 days from issuance unless W-9/TIN is received and final PO issued.

Action for procurement (Irene): please issue the PO and attach the onboarding form and a brief note: "Provisional PO — final PO to follow upon receipt of vendor tax documentation."

Maya — once Irene issues the provisional PO, please confirm you can invoice against the line items and route invoices to accounting@skyline-sys.com. If you can upload the signed W-9 today, we can convert the provisional PO to final sooner.

Thanks — Marcus
Senior Finance Manager | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com
From: Maya Evers <maya@skyline-sys.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-12-08T13:18:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: provisional PO and line-split for Skyline go-live

Hi Irene / Marcus / Connor,

Thanks — we can accept a provisional PO and invoice against the two line items. Our AP team requires a PO number to match invoices; they can process provisional POs but prefer the PO notes indicate temporary status. Attached is the signed W-9 (skyline_w9_signed.pdf) — apologies for the delay, we had to pull the corporate TIN.

Billing contact: Tom Hayes <thayes@skyline-sys.com>
Legal name: Skyline Systems, Inc.
Billing address: 980 Harbor Ave, Suite 400, San Mateo, CA 94404

We should be able to invoice for initial setup this week once we have the PO.

Best,
Maya Evers
Head of Partnerships | Skyline Systems
maya@skyline-sys.com | +1 650-555-0199

Attachment: skyline_w9_signed.pdf
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Maya Evers <maya@skyline-sys.com>
Date: 2026-12-09T15:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: provisional PO and line-split for Skyline go-live — PO issued

All — provisional PO has been created in the ERP. Details below and link to the PO record:

PO number: PO-STG-947-2026
Status: Provisional
Lines:
  - RDW-DEP-BASE — $15,000 (Deployment Setup)
  - RDW-ING-ADV — $10,000 (Data Ingest & Integration)
Expiry: 2026-12-23 (14 days)
Notes: "Provisional PO — final PO to replace upon receipt of vendor tax documentation (W-9/TIN). Vendor may invoice against the listed line items only. Contact procurement@redwoodinference.com for exceptions."

Attachments added to the PO record: skyline_onboard_form.pdf, skyline_w9_signed.pdf, po-template-ponum-staging.xlsx

Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PROC-1123 (internal PO workflow ticket)

Maya — please confirm you received PO-STG-947-2026 and that AP will proceed. Connor — I invited Monica to the ticket to help track go-live scheduling and billing alignment.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwoodinference.com
